hashConvention: sha256 over "<width>x<height>x<channels>:" followed by the decoded RGB(A) bytes, at the file's own resolution. Bytes are the committed PNG file size.

table.units: tile units: 1 unit = the 28 mm tile height, the same scale as shell-spec.json (0.75 wide, 0.58929 thick)

wall.note: Each run is 17 touching stacks, tile long axis perpendicular to the wall, two tiles high, every tile face-down (blue up). The ring radius is the wall centre line used by the baked front/back wall fans (eye y -47.8, wall centre y -/+7.0).

pond.note: 18 discards per pond in three 6-wide rows. Row 0 is nearest the discarding player (radius 4.6) and the rows advance toward the table centre. The pond outer edge (5.1) leaves a 1.4-unit gap to the wall inner edge, so the two-tier wall does not occlude the near row at the reference elevation. The tile long axis points along the seat's away axis, so the glyph reads for the seat.

hand.note: A standing 13-tile row with the blue back to the table centre and the face to the seat; the human also gets the separated drawn tile at +5.5125 (the compositor's +0.35 advance gap after the 13th tile).

meld.note: One open pon per seat inside the wall ring, beside the pond and on the seat's right (row radius 5.4, x from 2.6). The two upright tiles are 0.75 wide along the row; the called tile lies sideways (1.0 along the row).

felt.note: One flat cloth plane, no rail/compass/apron geometry. The runtime's full-screen felt raster and vignette belong to the compositor; the reference exists to compare tile bodies, not the background.
